applicability: Retry of an allocated curator family declaration whose authored content includes a nonempty retention set.
conditions: The declaration content binds exact retained membership IDs and normalized nonblank authored bases in deterministic membership-ID order.
Reordering the same retention set preserves its content identity and held allocation.
Changing the retained set or a basis under the allocated key is a content conflict requiring an explicit successor declaration under a new key.
Absent and empty retention both add no retention content to the existing declaration digest.
exclusions: Equal local labels or keys across distinct leaf scopes do not authorize reuse of another task’s allocation.
Formatting normalized by the parser is not a new semantic basis; this rule does not override source/candidate/publication admission.
statement: An allocated family declaration binds its nonempty retention set and authored bases; reordering the same set is an exact retry, while changing the set or bases is a content conflict.
